#### Description

Introducing the McKesson Rollator Walker with Seat and Wheels, the perfect mobility aid for those looking to maintain their independence. With its lightweight and durable aluminum construction, this rollator walker safely supports users up to 300 lbs. The adjustable handle height, ranging from 32 to 36 inches, ensures a comfortable fit for individuals of varying heights. The convenient padded seat provides a comfortable resting spot when needed, and the 6-inch wheels easily navigate over most surfaces. The rollator also includes a storage pouch for carrying personal items. Whether you're out running errands or enjoying a stroll in the park, this rollator walker is sure to make your life easier and more comfortable.

# Lumex Walkabout Lite Rollator – Lightweight 14.5 lb. Rolling Walker with Seat for Seniors, Aqua
Brand: Graham-Field
Category: Walkers, Rollators & Accessories > Rolling Walkers

## Features
Lightweight and Easy to Handle – At just 14.5 pounds, this rollator is one of the lightest in its class, making it easy to lift, steer, and fold for storage or travel.; Compact Frame for Tight Spaces – Measuring only 27.5” wide with 16” handgrip spacing, it’s ideal for maneuvering through narrow doorways, crowded rooms, or busy sidewalks.; Comfortable for Petite Users – Height-adjustable handgrips (32"–37") and a padded seat (22.5" high) make this rollator a great fit for shorter adults and seniors.; Smooth and Stable Performance – Large 6" solid rubber wheels glide effortlessly over indoor and outdoor surfaces, while the locking handbrakes provide added control and safety.; Comfort On the Go – The cushioned 14" x 13.5" seat and curved backrest offer a comfortable place to rest, and the lightweight frame folds quickly for easy transport.

## Specifications
Color: Aqua; Material Type: Aluminum; Age Range Description: Adult; Unit Count: 1 Count; Best Sellers Rank: #225,657 in Health & Household (See Top 100 in Health & Household)#359 in Rolling Walkers

## Pricing & Reviews
Price: 92.99 USD.
Rated 4.6 from 579 reviews.
Top review: This is an amazing rollator for the price. Sturdy, rolls beautifully, seat is ok comfy, wheels are a light gray color (much nicer than black), locking brakes work great, light enough to handle (14 lbs.).Secondly, it is NOT ANYTHING like the color shown in the picture. That color (which is what drew me to the walker in the first place) was a light aqua. The color we actually got is almost exactly the same as the blue on a package of Wet Ones Wipes. Not awful, but certainly NOT LIGHT AQUA. We've decided to live with it. But now I wish we'd gotten emerald green. Wonder why its so hard for sellers to get the color right in the ads. So, you take your chances on color with Graham-Field. Overall, we are very happy, and we recommend this walker highly. Color is a guessing game, but overall quality is there. A fun walker.

## Details
Model: Walkabout Lite. UPC: 717076107334

## Description
Product Description The Lumex Walkabout Lite Rollator is a stylish, ultra-light mobility solution designed to help adults and seniors walk with confidence. Weighing just 14.5 lbs, it’s easy to lift and store while providing dependable support and stability on the move. The compact frame fits through tight doorways and crowded spaces, while the adjustable handgrips and padded seat make it ideal for petite users. Trusted by healthcare professionals, Lumex walkers are built for comfort, mobility, and everyday ease. Manufacturer Contact Information 1-678-291-3207

## Product description 

 The Parvum rollator combines sophisticated design, high functionality and maximum suitability for everyday use in a lightweight, modern mobility aid. Weighing only 5.1 kg, it is one of the lightest models in its class - ideal for everyday use as well as for travel. The sturdy aluminium frame ensures reliable safety and easy handling. Whether at home, on the go or on holiday, this walker gives you back your mobility and independence. Thanks to the intelligent folding mechanism, the walker can be easily folded to a compact 74 x 24 x 84 cm. So it fits easily in the boot, a storage room or even in tight corners. The quick operational readiness makes it the perfect companion for spontaneous trips and daily shopping. The comfortable seat with the dimensions 46 x 20 cm, together with the removable backrest, offers a comfortable option for short breaks. With a seat height of 58 cm and a load capacity of up to 120 kg, it offers stability and comfort for users of any stature. The integrated brake system with handbrake and practical parking function ensures maximum safety. Reflectors increase visibility in the dark, while a tilting aid makes it easier to overcome curbs. Everything for a safe feeling - indoors and outdoors. The Parvum rollator is suitable for people with a height of 160 to 185 cm. Equipped with a stick holder and smooth, robust wheels, it is easy to manoeuvre on both smooth indoor floors and uneven outdoor surfaces. This makes it the ideal choice for seniors and anyone who wants to remain active and independent despite mobility restrictions.

## Product Description & Technical Details

### Product Overview

The Lightweight Rollator - Narrow Walker for Small Doorways with Basket and Tray by KMINA combines functionality, comfort, and style to support active mobility for adults and seniors. With a slim 21.3-inch frame and a lightweight 13.2 lbs. build, it is perfect for use in confined indoor spaces like hallways and doorways, while also being sturdy enough for outdoor use.
